title: Waluigi's Witness Commentary on 'The Archive Hall and the Song "Alone"'
subtitle: Six names on a cursed sheet, two Wa's too many, ten thousand missing gold, one crushed Fire Flower, and the night Wario turned down money in front of a Toad.
kicker: WITNESS DESK · ARCHIVE HALL VAULT · 1035 BF
pullQuote: Gold doesn't bring dead people back! — Wario, sober, in front of a witness, scar-cracking a stone wall while clutching a Feywild contract by its torn corners.
standfirst: Waluigi walks through every hour of 3 Aethel, 1035 BF inside the unguarded Archive Hall: the six-name clone song that slandered MY mustache and stole MY signature cry, Mr. T's catastrophic 'two Wa's' follow-up, Wario's self-appointed career as 'The Explosive Accountant', four capital words unread in the bottom-left margin, three hauntings in seven days culminating in five lines of Italian and a stolen book, and Wario losing his nerve in the corridor.

sections.heading: I. That Six-Name Musical Hate Crime, Line by Miserable Line
sections.body:
WAH! Sit down, pour yourself cold coffee, and read that first sheet straight through WITHOUT skipping the bracketed `[music]` cues, because Waluigi endured EVERY SINGLE SYLLABLE across raw oak with a twenty-four-hour-old rotor bruise throbbing behind MY left eye! Mr. T slides the page across the table like he is handing Waluigi cold gold and says, "I got what you wanted." THAT WAS NOT WHAT WALUIGI WANTED! Look at the opening roll call: Mario, Luigi, Wario, Waluigi, Bowser, and THEN, dropped onto the end like a dead fish nailed to a cello, Wario Bowser! WHO ON EARTH IS WARIO BOWSER?! Waluigi told Mr. T on the spot and Waluigi will shout it down every stone vault in this kingdom: "there's no Wario Bowser because *Wario* already IS Bowser for most games!" Think about Waluigi's professional life for FIVE SECONDS! Wario steals castles, Wario hoards treasure mountains, Wario throws his own employees down elevator shafts, and some anonymous lunatic sits in a basement begging corporate offices for MORE EVIL CLONES while Waluigi CANNOT EVEN GET INVITED TO MARIO KART 64 OR SUPER SMASH BROS.! THE SONG LITERALLY BRAGS ABOUT LEAVING WALUIGI OUT TO MY FACE!

Read the middle verse again if you think Waluigi is exaggerating ONE INCH! First it announces that Mario and Luigi are brothers and Wario is their cousin — ALREADY WRONG enough to curdle milk — and THEN it trails off into two brainless `[music]` breaks right after saying nobody knows if Waluigi is anything at all! NOBODY KNOWS?! ASK WALUIGI! WALUIGI IS SITTING AT THE TABLE! THEN the songwriter loses whatever marble remained inside his skull and writes that Mario has a zigzag mustache while Luigi has an L-shaped mustache AND THEN SAYS BOWSER DOESN'T HAVE A MUSTACHE, WALUIGI DOES, AND THEY LOOK VERY SIMILAR TO WALUIGI! BOWSER AND MY MUSTACHE DO NOT SHARE A POSTAL CODE, LET ALONE FACIAL GEOMETRY! THIS MAGNIFICENT WORK OF ARCHITECTURAL PRECISION TOOK WALUIGI YEARS OF WAX AND SPITE TO PERFECT, AND SOME CHORUS HACK RHYMED WALUIGI WITH WART BOWSER!

And DO NOT skip the ending! Four lines from the bottom, right after spelling M-A-R-I-O-W-A-L-U-I-G-I without spaces like a ransom demand, it shouts WALUIGI SAYS WAH and IMMEDIATELY hands MY SIGNATURE BATTLE CRY THREE TIMES IN A ROW TO WAWARIO! ONCE IN CAPITALS, TWICE IN CAPITALS, AND A THIRD TIME WHISPERED LIKE AN ENCORE! MY WAH! STOLEN ON WALUIGI'S OWN DESK WHILE MY WORKING NOTEBOOK IS STILL IN PAULO'S STUPID SYNDICATE SATCHEL FROM STAR HILL! Any lesser man would have eaten the paper whole! Waluigi left EVERY WORD intact so posterity can prosecute the author by hand!

sections.heading: II. 'Two Wa's' — Why the Pen Flew, Why My Name Got Blacked Out, and That Ceiling Stain
sections.body:
People reading from dry armchairs five years later love to chuckle when Waluigi throws office stationery across a stone vault. WAH! YOU TRY IT! First Mr. T drags Waluigi back from the doorway pretending he wants an intellectual explanation of rivalry theory: "Wario already IS Bowser for most games? What do you mean by that?" Fine! Waluigi loves logic! Waluigi sits back down, points straight at the giant purple letter on MY cap, and lays out elementary geometry for him — AND THEN THAT TINY SPECTACLED TOAD TILTS HIS HEAD AND DROPS "Wawaluigi. Two Wa's." INTO THE AIR LIKE IT COSTS NOTHING!

TWO WA'S! SAY IT OUT LOUD AND LISTEN TO YOUR OWN MOUTH TURN INTO A BROKEN DRAINPIPE! WAWALUGI! If you put two negatives in front of Luigi you are mathematically back at REGULAR GREEN LUIGI WITH WORSE POSTURE, WHICH ALREADY EXISTS DOWN THE CORRIDOR IN A COMA! For YEARS the entire Mushroom Kingdom treated Waluigi like a spare umbrella left behind at a tennis tournament — no solo billing, two measly lives while Mario waltzes around burning three per stage, zero respect — and NOW instead of paying Waluigi ONE GOLD COIN OF BACK ROYALTIES, the universe invents a DOUBLE-PREFIX COUNTERFEIT TO STAND NEXT TO WALUIGI?! YES MY CHAIR TIPPED! YES WALUIGI'S PEN FLEW ACROSS THE ROOM AND MISSED THE MARK BY FOUR FEET! THAT NIB WAS BENT FROM THE STAR HILL ROOFTOP AND WALUIGI'S RIBS WERE BRUISED PURPLE!

Look at what Waluigi ACTUALLY DID once the red mist cleared half an inch: Waluigi picked that pen back up off the stone, walked to the oak table, and drove ONE SOLID BLACK BAR straight across MY OWN NAME until not one fiber of white parchment showed underneath. "Scrap this whole mess. No more confusion. No more evil versions. This isn't about the Wa characters. This is about ME." REMEMBER THAT LINE WHEN YOU READ THE NEXT FIVE HOURS OF THIS NIGHT! Because outside in Star Hill, three copies of Mr. L had JUST sung about killing Mario, Promo Mario had JUST played statesman on film, and an hour later a FOURTH broken green brother walked straight into THIS VERY ROOM! Waluigi smelled identity rot in the mortar before anybody else even opened a cabinet!

And DO NOT gloss over what happened five minutes after Waluigi clicked that door shut with "Don't wait up" and walked into the rain! Mr. T looks ten feet straight up at solid stone — NO CRACK, NO PIPE SEAM — asks "Is the ceiling leaking?" out loud, watches dark water spread out of nowhere right above Waluigi's open red-stained grimoire, AND GOES TO SLEEP UNDER IT! ONLY MR. T COULD WATCH A VAULT START BLEEDING RAIN OVER SECRET BOOKS AND CALL IT A LULLABY!

sections.heading: III. 'The Explosive Accountant' — Brass Keys, Big Mouths, and Who Owes Whom
sections.body:
WAH HA HA! EVERY TIME WALUIGI GETS GLOOMY FOR TEN MINUTES, ALL WALUIGI HAS TO DO IS RE-READ WARIO'S ENTRANCE AND MY WILL TO LIVE DOUBLES! Picture poor half-dead Mr. T drooling on inventory schedules under a dripping ceiling while Wario tiptoes in wet from the storm, circles the chair LIKE A GARLIC-SCENTED SHARK, pokes the back of his neck, leans into his ear with "Wake up, sleepyhead." AND THEN POSES WITH BOTH THUMBS IN HIS VEST SHOUTING: "I am Wario! The Explosive Accountant! And you're just... what exactly are you supposed to be?" NOBODY CALLED HIM THAT! NOBODY IN TEN YEARS OF COMMERCE HAS EVER CALLED WARIO AN ACCOUNTANT WITHOUT THE WORD EMBEZZLER ATTACHED BY STAPLES!

Now listen closely to what Wario puts on the oak table BEFORE he knows Waluigi has come back down the corridor with MY ears pressed flat against the glass! First, Wario claims he spent THREE STRAIGHT HOURS checking Waluigi's morning schedules against his own grimoire and caught a ten-thousand-gold gap between column seven and column nine PLUS a client deposit stamped almost two weeks before any real deal happened. WAIT RIGHT THERE! Did Waluigi cook that sheet? NO! IF WALUIGI WAS GOING TO SKIM TEN THOUSAND GOLD OFF WARIO, DO YOU SERIOUSLY THINK WALUIGI WOULD LEAVE COLUMN SEVEN SITTING TWO INCHES FROM COLUMN NINE ON THE SAME PIECE OF PAPER?! PLEASE! INSULT WALUIGI'S MORALS ALL WEEK LONG, NEVER INSULT WALUIGI'S ARITHMETIC!

Second, watch Wario casually pull a SMALL BRASS KEY out of his inner coat pocket and brag that he ALREADY opened locked Archive Hall cabinets earlier and found things he refuses to name! Hold EVERYTHING! Five minutes later this SAME MAN throws a purple-faced fit screaming that the Archive Hall is a sacred fortress nobody can touch — AFTER UNLOCKING ITS DRAWERS HIMSELF WITH POCKET BRASS! AND THEN HE TELLS MR. T: "We're family... He owes me money. Big time. And then he has the audacity to send me paperwork that might be fake?" OH, WE'RE FAMILY NOW WHEN THE AUDIT GOES SIDEWAYS, ARE WE, WARIO?! Twenty-four hours ago on a smashed clinic roof Wario threw WALUIGI'S WORKING NOTEBOOK AT AN ARMED SYNDICATE COURIER FOR ZERO GOLD AND SPLIT OUR DEAL SIXTY-THIRTY IN HIS OWN FAVOR WHILE WALUIGI WAS CONCUSSED! Waluigi remembers EVERY SINGLE COIN OF OUR TAB, FAT MAN, AND WHEN YOU SUBTRACT ONE HELICOPTER CRASH PLUS ONE LOST MANUSCRIPT, CHECK WHOSE COLUMN IS BLEEDING RED!

sections.heading: IV. Four Words in the Bottom-Left Corner That Should Hang Over Wario's Bed Forever
sections.body:
YES, WALUIGI CAME BACK IN WITH A FRESH BRUISE ON MY CHEEK AND A BADLY SCORCHED NOTEBOOK CLUTCHED AGAINST MY CHEST — AND NO, WALUIGI IS STILL NOT TELLING PUBLIC READERS WHAT SCORCHED THOSE EDGES IN TWENTY MINUTES OUTSIDE! Waluigi told Wario flatly: "I got here about twenty minutes ago" and "I was just dealing with some... complications." If people start shouting about an emergency down the clinic hallway five seconds after Waluigi closes a glass door, WALUIGI'S ONLY COMMENT IS THAT CORRELATION IS NOT CAUSATION, WAH! Keep your eyes where they belong: on Mr. T walking quietly over to the oak shelves and pulling down TWO GIANT VOLUMES AT RANDOM WHILE WARIO IS BUSY SCREAMING ABOUT CONSPIRACIES!

LOOK AT THAT SCENE! Wario has spent THREE HOURS sweating over loose morning sheets, and Mr. T simply reaches up one shelf and hands him *The Complete Ledger of Wario's Enterprise* — BOTH REAL BACKUP VOLUMES — SITTING WIDE OPEN IN A ROOM WITH ZERO GUARDS! Wario goes bug-eyed yelling: "Public? You think THIS Archive Hall is just some public library where anyone can wander in off the street?! This place houses the most sensitive financial records in all of civilization!" AND BOTH MR. T AND WALUIGI HAVE TO TELL HIM TO HIS FACE THAT WE HAVE WALKED IN AND OUT OF THIS PLACE FOR MONTHS WITHOUT SEEING ONE SINGLE GUARD! NOT ONE HALBERD! NOT ONE SLEEPING TOAD IN A CHAIR! Whoever stripped the guard post off this vault months ago wanted people walking out with secrets OR planting fake pages right on top of real ones — INCLUDING THAT FIVE-THOUSAND-GOLD WITHDRAWAL AND ONE-MONTH RE-DEPOSIT ON THE TREASURY OF WONDERS!

AND THEN COMES THE GREATEST MOMENT IN RECORDED FINANCIAL HISTORY! Mr. T deadpans one little question — "Yeah, this is definitely fraud. Should I contact the TPF — Toad Police Force?" — AND WARIO NEARLY SWALLOWS HIS OWN MUSTACHE WHOLE! "WAIT!" Wario barks! "Do NOT contact them! Do not tell a single soul about this!" WHY? BECAUSE EVERY TOAD IN TOADSTON WITH HALF A CLIPBOARD WOULD FLIP WARIO UPSIDE DOWN BY HIS ANKLES IF THEY OPENED THAT FUND! AND THEN MR. T FLIPS THE PAGE OVER TO THE BOTTOM-LEFT CORNER! READ IT AGAIN IN SOLID GOLD CAPITALS:

`AUDIT REQUIRED - WARIO`

MR. T HAD ALREADY FOUND IT MONTHS AGO, WRITTEN WARIO'S OWN NAME AFTER A HYPHEN IN THE CORNER OF THE DAILY REPORT, HANDED IT STRAIGHT TO WARIO'S DESK, AND WARIO NEVER READ DOWN TO THE BOTTOM OF HIS OWN PAGE! "Of COURSE you told me. I'm a fool." HIS EXACT WORDS IN FRONT OF WALUIGI! TATTOO IT ON WALUIGI'S TOMBSTONE SO WALUIGI CAN LAUGH UNDERGROUND!

sections.heading: V. Three Hauntings in Seven Days, Wario's Slip About the Breach, and One Murdered Flower
sections.body:
Laugh all you want at Wario's bookkeeping — EVERYTHING FUNNY IN THAT VAULT DIED THE SECOND BOOTS SOUNDED IN THE EMPTY CLINIC HALLWAY! Remember WHERE the Archive Hall sits! Connected corridors running straight toward Star Hill's medical wards, dead hours of the night, rain hammering stone lancets, Waluigi tucking the ledger tight under MY arm and whispering "Shit" before ducking behind the oak stacks while Wario clamps one glove straight over the pocket holding his precious contract and drags Mr. T into deep cover: "Stay completely silent. If we move even an inch, they'll hear us."

FIRST: DO NOT GLIDE PAST WARIO'S WHISPER BEHIND THE SHELF AFTER THE DOORWAY CHORUS VANISHES! "That was the third haunting this week," Wario mutters bitterly — "First Boo's ghost, then that giant moth thing from last week... Now THIS? I'm starting to think the Archive Hall has a grudge against Wario's Enterprise." THREE HAUNTINGS IN ONE WEEK INSIDE ONE UNGUARDED VAULT! Not one random ghost wandering lost through plaster — THREE SEPARATE ENTITIES CROSSING INTO THE EXACT SAME ROOM SEVEN DAYS APART! AND TEN SECONDS LATER WARIO BLURTS OUT THE REASON RIGHT TO BETA LUIGI'S FACE: "Maybe this whole Feywild breach was a mistake that's going to cost us everything — so are you going to stand there holding flowers like some kind of funeral bouquet, or tell me what's going on?!" WRITE THOSE TWO WORDS IN THREE-INCH LETTERS ACROSS YOUR FOREHEAD: FEYWILD BREACH! WARIO SAID IT OUT LOUD!

SECOND: LOOK AT WHO WALKED THROUGH THAT DOOR! Not clinic Luigi lying under clean white sheets down the hall, NOT blue-coat Mr. L smirking outside in triplicate — a hollow, wax-faced wreck in stained green overalls and heavy leather tool belt with dreadful bruised bags hanging under barely open eyes, humming softly over losing his big brother across King Boo's chasm while carrying A REAL WORKING FIRE FLOWER IN HIS HANDS! WAH! WALUIGI'S HEART STILL SPLINTERS REMEMBERING THAT HEAVY WORK BOOT COMING STRAIGHT DOWN ON THOSE GLOWING PETALS! "WHAT THE— Don't you DARE!" Waluigi shouted before MY brain even caught up with MY legs! "That was a perfect flower! A WORKING flower with actual power and you just CRUSHED IT!" Do NOT laugh at Waluigi yelling about a flower in the middle of a haunting! Waluigi knows EXACTLY what crushing live fire under your own heel means: IT MEANS THE MAN IN GREEN HAD ALREADY DECIDED HE NEVER WANTED ANOTHER EXTRA LIFE AGAIN!

sections.heading: VI. Fifteen Feet of Crimson Rage, My Scattered Pages, and Five Lines of Italian
sections.body:
Anybody who claims he stood tall and heroic through the next ten minutes of that night is a liar who was NOT in the room! When Waluigi slammed both palms into that oak bookcase yelling "Brother! Do NOT stand there weeping about Mario! You think King Boo cared about your feelings when he trapped him?!" and Wario lunged forward trying to grab Beta Luigi by the shoulders, THE AIR BETWEEN THE STACKS TURNED SOLID! Ghosts surged forward like an iron wall and threw Wario stumbling backward on his heels while Beta Luigi stared straight through the barrier singing his heart out into raw stone!

Then came the crash in the lower vaults — and THE TEMPERATURE IN THAT ARCHIVE DROPPED TWENTY DEGREES IN ONE HEARTBEAT! Fifteen feet tall, arms thick as oak trunks, burning angry crimson right up under the leaking ceiling beams while Wario crossed his arms with dead-eyed stubbornness holding up a paper ledger chart like stationery stops a giant spirit! AND WALUIGI? WALUIGI WILL TELL YOU THE TRUTH WITHOUT ONE WORD OF VANITY! Waluigi's knees buckled straight down onto those freezing flags! MY scorched second notebook spilled open across the wet stone — EVERY frantic page Waluigi had scribbled outside on spectral barriers and quantum entanglement fluttering around MY boots — and REAL TEARS CUT THROUGH THE SOOT ON WALUIGI'S FACE! "Brother! BROTHER! I'm sorry! I'm SO sorry!" YES, WALUIGI WEPT ON HIS KNEES IN THAT HALL! Listen to that boy sobbing that his cowardice cost his brother's life and tell Waluigi YOUR knees stay locked!

AND THEN MARIO ANSWERED OUT OF EMPTY AIR IN ITALIAN! Faint at first, then crystal clear across stone walls with NO speaker, NO pipe, NO trick: "Luigi, where did you go? I'm stranded, lost and alone." And then in the old tongue: "Luigi, where did you go? Ti perdono. Vai avanti." *I forgive you. Go on.* "Tocca a te salvarli." *It is up to you to save them.* "Mario non c'è più — non farmi morire invano." *Mario is no more — do not let me die in vain.* "Mostra loro che sei il fratello..." "...di Mario! Sei Luigi!" EVERY PHANTOM CUT OFF AT THE EXACT SAME INSTANT! Beta Luigi hit the stones, whispered that he would make them atone ALONE, stood back up, REACHED ONTO THE PHYSICAL OAK SHELF WITH A SOLID HAND, PULLED DOWN ONE REAL BOUND BOOK, AND WALKED OUT THE DOOR! GHOSTS DO NOT STEAL BOOKS, IDIOTS! CHECK THAT EMPTY SLOT ON THE SHELF FIRST THING IN THE MORNING!

sections.heading: VII. 'Gold Doesn't Bring Dead People Back' — Two Contracts, One Name, and Skinny T
sections.body:
If you think the haunting was the strangest miracle of 3 Aethel, 1035 BF, WAIT SIXTY SECONDS FOR THE CORRIDOR! Beta Luigi vanishes down the passage with mystery archive volume number one tucked under his arm. Waluigi walks straight to the open doorway clutching MY worn grimoire pages because SOMEBODY with working eyes has to watch which turn he takes: "Sometimes you don't get second chances because there weren't any first chances to begin with." Behind Waluigi, sensible little courier Mr. T does ordinary mercenary arithmetic out loud: "He said Mario, right? That means the Mario disappearance case — it was a side thing, I know, but Wario, think of the gold we can get if we bring Mario back!" Nine hundred and ninety-nine nights out of a thousand, Wario's pupils turn into spinning gold coins and he tackles Mr. T through the plaster to sign finder's forms!

NOT ON 3 AETHEL! Wario whips his head sideways, yanks that dog-eared Contract of Accord out of his coat hard enough to crack stiff parchment, slams HIS BARE FIST STRAIGHT INTO SOLID CORRIDOR STONE, AND SCREAMS WORDS WALUIGI NEVER THOUGHT MORTAL EARS WOULD HEAR OUT OF WARIO'S MOUTH: "Enough!" and then "I don't care if there's gold involved, Mr. T! Gold doesn't bring dead people back!" WAH! READ THAT LINE TWICE AND CHISEL IT INTO MARBLE! Wario is NOT performing charity for newspaper cameras — nobody is standing in that dim gaslit passage except ONE TOAD COURIER! Listen to what Wario admits ten seconds later when Mr. T asks about the torn parchment in his fist: "This isn't a book. It's a contract. And right now it's the only thing keeping me from walking away from all of this because I know damn well that if I don't fix this somehow, there won't be any coming back — not for anyone." AND THEN HE CALLS IT ONE OF "these Feywild contracts" TO MR. T'S FACE! TWENTY-FOUR HOURS EARLIER ON WALUIGI'S OUTPOST BALCONY HE USED THAT EXACT SAME NAME FOR OUR SIXTY-THIRTY PARTNERSHIP DEAL! Either Wario carries TWO contracts under one title OR he hid a lethal Feywild default clause underneath Star Hill AND NOW THE BILL IS COLLECTING HAUNTINGS THREE TIMES A WEEK!

AND ONE LAST GIFT FROM WALUIGI'S MEMORY BEFORE WALUIGI LOCKS THIS FILE! Listen to Wario's parting insult to Mr. T in the dark hallway — calling him "a courier who knows too much about gambling debts." REWIND TWENTY-FOUR HOURS TO OUTSIDE DR. TOAD'S CLINIC WHEN SYNDICATE COURIER PAULO SQUINTED AT MR. L IN GREEN AND SAID HE DIDN'T KNOW SKINNY T WORE GREEN! Same hill! Same clinic complex! A thin, underslept Toad courier named MR. T cleaning Wario's dirty laundry and gambling tabs! EVERY PIECE CONNECTS WHEN WALUIGI HOLDS THE PEN — EVEN AFTER THROWING IT AT A WALL! WAH!

sections.heading: VIII. Twenty Minutes in the Storm — Why My Second Notebook Came Back Black Around the Edges
sections.body:
WAIT A SECOND — nobody leaves this desk without talking properly about the twenty-minute gap between Waluigi walking out into the downpour and Waluigi pressing MY cold wet ears flat against that Archive Hall glass! Everybody stares at Wario waving ledgers and forgets what walked back in through that door! Waluigi left ONE working notebook in Paulo's courier satchel the night before on Star Hill, left MY heavy grimoire open in red ink right beside sleeping Mr. T on the oak table, stepped out into pouring rain with NOTHING except a spare pocket pad and a bruised cheekbone — AND CAME BACK TWENTY MINUTES LATER WITH FRESH CONTUSIONS AND FOUR SCORCHED BLACK MARGINS SMELLING OF OZONE AND BURNT RAG PAPER! WAH!

Listen to what happened five seconds AFTER Waluigi pulled that door shut behind ME: boots pounding down the distant clinic passage and voices yelling about an emergency! Wario looks straight at Waluigi's face, sees the fresh mark swelling under MY eye, steps closer, and gets shut down cold: "I got here about twenty minutes ago" and "I was just dealing with some... complications. That's none of your concern right now." WHY DID WALUIGI KEEP THOSE PAGES PRESSED TIGHT AGAINST MY CHEST UNTIL THE FIFTEEN-FOOT RED SPIRIT KNOCKED WALUIGI ONTO HIS KNEES?! Look at the two subjects scribbled across those singed leaves when they scattered across the stone flags: spectral barriers and quantum entanglement!

DO THE ARITHMETIC WITH YOUR OWN BRAIN FOR ONCE! Waluigi walked out of the Archive Hall furious about evil doubles and counterfeit prefixes — AND WITHIN FIVE STEPS OF THE CLINIC CORRIDORS RAN HEADFIRST INTO LIVE ECTOPLASMIC SPILLOVER ALREADY LEAKING THROUGH THE COMPLEX BEFORE BETA LUIGI EVER REACHED OUR DOOR! That ceiling stain ten feet above Mr. T's sleeping skull did NOT open because Star Hill hired bad roofers! The rain coming down outside hit a thinning seam between worlds where a Boo had crossed days earlier, where a giant moth had crossed the week before, and where something hot enough to char damp paper scorched MY pocket pad while Waluigi was taking field notes in the dark! Anybody else in this kingdom gets jumped by corridor anomalies at midnight and sprints straight for a ferry ticket! Waluigi wiped the soot off MY chin, tucked the scorched pages against MY ribs, marched STRAIGHT BACK TO THE ARCHIVE DOOR, listened through the glass until Wario finished incriminating himself, AND CAME BACK INSIDE TO FINISH THE AUDIT! NAME ONE HERO ON A CEREAL BOX WITH HALF THAT SPINE! YOU CAN'T!

sections.heading: IX. Five Lines in the Old Tongue — Why Even Waluigi Stopped Breathing
sections.body:
Now shut the door, blow out half the gas lamps in your head, and listen AGAIN to those five lines that came out of empty stone when Beta Luigi hit rock bottom — because Waluigi has spent YEARS despising Mario's red cap, Mario's rigged three-life safety net, Mario's effortless applause, AND YET WALUIGI REFUSES TO CHEAPEN WHAT SPOKE INSIDE THAT ROOM! WAH! If Waluigi wanted to lie to make himself look cold-blooded and untouchable, Waluigi owned the pen! Waluigi could have scraped MY own tears straight off the page in thirty seconds! Waluigi DID NOT SCRAPE ONE DROP!

Listen to the exact cadence of how that voice arrived. Not booming off the rafters like a stage wizard trying to scare children — FAINT FIRST, barely audible through rain on lancet glass, asking one plain human question: "Luigi, where did you go? I'm stranded, lost and alone." Think about what that first sentence DOES to every smug rumor floating around Toad Town! Not 'I am vacationing on an island!' Not 'wait for my triumphant press tour!' *Stranded, lost, and alone!* And watch how Beta Luigi answers BEFORE he even registers whether the voice is inside his own skull or standing in the room: "Oh, Mario, where do I go? The kingdom's lost and alone."

AND THEN THE VOICE CLARIFIES AND DROPS STRAIGHT INTO ITALIAN! Why Italian?! Because no Toad clerk, no Koopa forger, no cheap illusionist running a parlor trick in Star Hill speaks to Luigi in their private household tongue when nobody is supposed to hear! *Ti perdono. Vai avanti.* I forgive you — go forward! *Tocca a te salvarli.* It falls to YOU to save them now! *Mario non c'è più — non farmi morire invano.* Mario is gone — do not let me die in vain! And then the split line where brother talks straight over brother sobbing that he still had so much left to prove: *Mostra loro che sei il fratello... di Mario! Sei Luigi!* SHOW THEM YOU ARE MARIO'S BROTHER — YOU ARE LUIGI!

WAH! Read that again and tell Waluigi why EVERY SINGLE GHOST IN THE HALL WENT DEAD SILENT ON THE FINAL WORD! The crimson giant vanished! The invisible wall locking Wario and Waluigi behind the bookcase vanished! Even the thunder outside held its tongue while water dripped once, twice, three times onto cold stone! Whatever reached across from wherever Mario is trapped spent EVERY LAST SPARK OF SIGNAL IT HAD JUST TO TELL ONE BROKEN GREEN WRECK TO STAND BACK UP! And when Beta Luigi stood up, he did NOT smile, he did NOT thank heaven, and he did NOT ask Wario or Waluigi for help — he whispered that they laughed at him, swore he would make them atone ALONE, pulled one bound book off the oak shelf, AND WALKED OUT!

sections.heading: X. Closing the Night's Tab — Four People, Four Doors, Zero Safe Exits
sections.body:
Step back ten paces from the oak table and count what actually walked out of the Archive Hall at the close of 3 Aethel, 1035 BF, because every amateur historian in this city misses half the board when he only watches the loudest man in the corridor! WAH! Waluigi counts ALL FOUR PLAYERS AND EVERY OBJECT IN THEIR HANDS!

Player Number One: **Beta Luigi** — out first into the rain, alone by sworn oath, boots wet with crushed Fire Flower sap, Mario's forgiveness ringing behind his eyes, carrying ONE UNIDENTIFIED BOUND BOOK PULLED STRAIGHT OFF THE ARCHIVE SHELVES! Until Waluigi checks every empty gap between those oak uprights tomorrow, assume whoever wrote or owned that missing volume is NEXT ON HIS LIST!

Player Number Two: **Wario** — out down the clinic corridor scar-fisted and white around the knuckles, clutching *The Complete Ledger of Wario's Enterprise* under one arm, a brass cabinet key in one pocket, and a torn, dog-eared parchment he calls ONE OF "these Feywild contracts" in his bare fist AFTER screaming "Gold doesn't bring dead people back!" at full volume! Let Waluigi underline that twice in purple ink: a Wario who turns down gold because a contract threatens total erasure is ten times more dangerous than a greedy Wario — because a scared Wario swings blind!

Player Number Three: **Mr. T** — dragged straight down that dim passage at Wario's heels whether he likes it or not! Do NOT underestimate that tiny tired Toad for ONE SECOND! Tonight alone he delivered the clone sheet, slept through a supernatural ceiling leak, pulled two needle-in-a-haystack backup ledgers off unindexed shelves ON THE FIRST REACH, humiliated Wario with `AUDIT REQUIRED - WARIO` in four tiny block words, AND accidentally answered Paulo's mystery from last night about skinny T! Mr. T knows EVERY dirty secret inside Wario's books AND Waluigi's tabs — if anything eats Mr. T in that corridor, half the financial memory of Star Hill dies with him!

And Player Number Four: **Waluigi!** Standing right on the threshold between the haunted room and the dark passage with MY scorched quantum-entanglement notes in MY pocket, MY worn grimoire pages tight against MY ribs, MY name blacked out in permanent ink so NO DOUBLE, NO WAWARIO, AND NO WAWALUGI EVER WEARS IT, AND BOTH COMPLETE SONGS LOCKED INTO WALUIGI'S ARCHIVE FOREVER! Nobody erases Waluigi! Nobody outlasts Waluigi! NOW HAND ME DRY BOOTS AND FIND OUT WHICH BOOK THAT GREEN LUNATIC TOOK! WAH!

sections.heading: XI. Postscript from Waluigi's Blotter — Why Every Last Syllable Stayed Uncut
sections.body:
ONE FINAL WORD FOR EVERY FUSSY CLERK WHO EVER ASKED WHY WALUIGI DID NOT SUMMARIZE TWO SONGS INTO THREE NEAT SENTENCES AND SAVE INK! WAH! Put your red pencil back inside your ear before Waluigi snaps it in half! Think about how every fraud inside that stone hall operated tonight: somebody took real events, trimmed out one inconvenient line, shifted one date two weeks sideways, swapped one summary sheet on top of two thick volumes nobody bothered opening, AND WATCHED GROWN MEN SCREAM AT EACH OTHER FOR HOURS OVER A COUNTERFEIT!

Waluigi DOES NOT RUN WARIO'S DESK! On Waluigi's desk you get EVERY rotten bracketed `[music]` marker on the first sheet AND EVERY broken gasp and Italian line on the second sheet — because FIVE YEARS FROM NOW in 1040 BF, when half the witnesses have amnesia and the other half pretend King Boo was a fairy tale invented to sell lanterns, some smug palace archivist WILL claim nobody ever heard Mario speak after the mansion! TRY CLAIMING THAT OVER WALUIGI'S RECORD!
